address: 6 Park Street, Borough Market, London, SE1 9AB, United Kingdom
bio: The cuisine of southern Thailand provides the inspiration for this bustling restaurant in the equally bustling Borough Market. It’s an extremely popular place and rightly so, with attractive pricing, efficient service and downright delicious cooking. The menu lends itself to sharing and each dish is packed with flavour, including the terrific grilled mussel skewers and some lip-tingling curries. If you can’t decide, opt for the set menu to share – which is also available in a vegan form....
